summary.text: Mary Bentley is serving her sixth term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 54, which includes portions of Yell, Pope, Perry, Saline and Conway counties.

paragraphs.text: She graduated from Harding University in 1983 with a Bachelor of Science in Nursing and practiced for over a decade in the cardiovascular intensive care unit at Arkansas Children's Hospital.
She has been owner and CEO of Bentley Plastics in Perryville since 2000 and lives in Perry County.
